why: THE MEANEST BRACKET 4 EDGAR. Opened 2026-10-18 from v2.0.0 after the first DeckCheck scan (DTI 28/96, B4) and roast. Build from the watch set deckcheck-mean-v1: answer exile and bounce wipes (Clever Concealment, the Enduring pair), death-triggered draw for the turn 7-8 empty hand, distance drain, cheaper Vampire casts. Champion kill_by_8 0.648 on the 2026-10-18 model; the objective is ONE column — resilience, curve shape, late pop-off and play decide with it. Swaps discussed slot by slot before staging.
